_source: Seljuk_Units_and_Strongholds.txt (Strongholds player aid) + Rules 1.3.1, 4.5.1, 4.9.1. Garrison archers (all Strongholds in Storm): Missile 0.5, -1 target Armor, select target. All dice d6.

aleppo_overrides._note: Aleppo always uses the Seljuk Garrison column regardless of current allegiance (Fatimid Caliphate, 1.3.1).
special_rules: Roman may not Withdraw inside Aleppo (or Hama)
Roman does not auto-succeed at Forage at Aleppo (or Hama)
Aleppo Independence event (R14) can make it Friendly to both sides; neither may Withdraw inside
If Aleppo Independence has been played for effect AND Seljuks hold Aleppo through the next Winter, Seljuk automatic victory (4.7.6, 5.2)

surrender._rule: 4.5.1. Roll dice = Stronghold value (4 for Aleppo). Each die <= (Siege markers + Ravaged markers, max 4 Siege + 0/1 Ravaged) seizes the Stronghold.

rules: Garrison Foot units have BOTH Melee and Missiles.
Garrison Infantry/Militia are x1/2 Missile units with -1 to target Armor; Select Targets (4.8.2).
Garrison Strikes add to the Defending Lord's Strikes (round up); Garrisons are otherwise separate from the Lord and ignore cards affecting the Lord individually.
Defender must assign Hits to Garrison units first; the Lord's Forces absorb Hits only after the Garrison is Routed.
Garrison units return to the pool when Routed or at end of Storm.
The full Garrison complement defends in every enemy Storm action regardless of past Storms.
Fatimid Caliphate Strongholds (Hama, Aleppo, Syria) always use the Seljuk Garrison column.
R16 Armenian Garrisons: Roman-conquered Strongholds outside the Roman Empire receive Garrison units from BOTH columns simultaneously.

themata_service_markers.source_location: the Stronghold's Thema box on the map
themata_service_markers.selection: Roman player chooses available Themata in that Thema to defend at the start of a Siege (4.3.5), up to the Stronghold Size
themata_service_markers.on_storm_win: defending Themata remain in the Stronghold
themata_service_markers.on_storm_loss: defending Themata are permanently removed from the game (Sack 4.9.1; also 4.5.1 Surrender)
